lines: Six polish builders are an hour in: the hand's weight, the base changing in the open, the mirror, the glass, the liquid's lag, the storm's drawing. First looks are in from five; nothing is landed yet, and I land nothing without its proofs and my own look.
The liquid builder found the engine's cloud now swings 20 mm inside the glass, yet the picture still shows one even green disc at the swap; it is tracing what paints that disc.
Next: land the multisampled levels and the finished interface, then Round 18, the first round on the whole globe.
phase 5: 1.28 h used of its 12.00 h box
allowance (before the review, continuation 1): 1.28 h used of 12.00 h allowed

pictures.caption: The strokes today, every film frame 2829 to 2838 of the fall to winter shake (review tier): the lean peaks on the turn and is level again by 2836, and the base cuts hard at 2834. This is what the hand and swap builders are changing.

Smoother edges in the live app, native size: top the published build, bottom the build with multisampling (frost, rim, branches). Six of its eight proof keys are back byte-identical; fall and the gate checks are still out.
New for the interface critic: every control at rest, focused and pressed, cut from the wide screen at its real size.
New for the interface critic: the Shake control's hint, twelve steps across its 1.9 second pulse.
